issues.description: Potential information disclosure via revoke_error in lease lookup response
issues.detail: The PR author explicitly flags this concern. RevokeErr is returned verbatim to any caller authorized to look up leases. Raw upstream errors can leak backend internals (URLs, hostnames, credentials in connection strings, file paths). Consider sanitizing or gating behind a privileged capability, since the original log-only audience is a higher trust tier than lease-lookup callers.

issues.description: Public API rename FetchLeaseTimes -> FetchLeaseInfo breaks external callers
issues.detail: FetchLeaseTimes is an exported method on ExpirationManager. Renaming (rather than adding a new method and deprecating the old) is a breaking change for any out-of-tree consumers (plugins, forks, downstream products). Consider keeping FetchLeaseTimes as a thin wrapper that delegates to FetchLeaseInfo, marked deprecated.

issues.description: namespace field copied from cached leaseEntry may not be populated for pending/irrevocable paths
issues.detail: leaseInfoForExport now copies le.namespace, but the cached pendingInfo.cachedLeaseInfo is built via inMemoryLeaseInfo, which itself calls leaseInfoForExport on the original le. If the original le.namespace was never set on the in-memory copy path (e.g., for older entries or restored leases), namespace_path will silently be omitted. Worth verifying namespace is always populated on the source entries used by both pending and irrevocable maps.

issues.description: OpenAPI declares 'path' as Required:true but lookups against missing/unknown leases return errors before that field is set
issues.detail: Marking path as Required:true in the response schema is fine for the success path, but if any code path returns a partial lease (e.g., legacy entries without Path persisted), the response will violate the schema. Low risk but worth confirming Path is always populated on persisted leaseEntry.

issues.description: Test mixes namespace.RootContext(nil) with t.Context() inconsistently
issues.detail: Line 2450 was changed to namespace.RootContext(t.Context()) while line 3104 still uses namespace.RootContext(nil). The inconsistency is harmless but suggests an incomplete refactor; pick one style for clarity.

issues.description: Test for new fields only asserts 'path'; namespace_path and revoke_error untested
issues.detail: TestSystemBackend_leases now checks resp.Data["path"] but adds no coverage for namespace_path (populated when a namespace is set) or revoke_error (populated on revoke failure). Given these are the headline additions, at least one test exercising each conditional branch would prevent silent regressions.

review.summary: The PR cleanly extends lease lookup with path, namespace_path, and revoke_error, with a sensible rename of FetchLeaseTimes to FetchLeaseInfo and matching test updates. Two concerns stand out: the author's own flagged risk that revoke_error may leak sensitive backend detail to any lease-lookup caller, and the breaking rename of an exported method that downstream consumers may depend on. Remaining items are test-coverage gaps for the new conditional fields and a minor context-style inconsistency in tests. Overall well-scoped, but the revoke_error disclosure decision deserves an explicit security review before merge.
